unit: MIT Jameel Clinic (Abdul Latif Jameel Clinic for Machine Learning in Health)
notes: Jameel Clinic is a cross-departmental AI-for-health initiative, not a PI-led lab itself. Its Leadership (Regina Barzilay, AI Faculty Lead, EECS; James J. Collins, Life Sciences Faculty Lead, Biological Engineering) and listed 'Principal Investigators' (e.g. Dimitris Bertsimas/Sloan, Fotini Christia/Political Science, Connor Coley/ChemE, Joey Davis/Biology, Randall Davis/EECS, Elazer Edelman/IMES) are MIT faculty whose primary labs are recorded in their home departments -- not duplicated here. Advisory Board is mostly external industry/academic leaders, not MIT researchers. Recorded empty per the project's cross-cutting-hub convention.
